text_block_list.text: Oh, no... Don't worry about it!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That machine has such a weak arm. It's
no wonder
you couldn't get anything!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It really needs to do some serious muscle
training!
It's not your fault, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
